PRIVATE MEMORY 1

Memory 01

🔐 06/06/2025
Jab aap ne specially hamare liye apne haathon par yeh mehndi lagwayi thi… us waqt shayad aap ko andaza bhi nahi tha ke aap ka yeh chhota sa gesture mere liye kitna special ban jayega. Aap ne apna waqt diya, apne haathon ko itna khoobsurat banaya, aur mere liye ek aisi yaad chhor di jo aaj bhi dil ko bohat pyari lagti hai. ❤️

Kuch yaadein tasveer se zyada hoti hain — un mein kisi ka pyaar, care aur woh feeling hoti hai jo seedha dil tak jati hai. Aur yeh unhi yaadon mein se ek hai. 🫶🏻
PRIVATE MEMORY 2

Memory 02

🔐 08/06/2025
Kabhi kabhi kisi ek lamhe mein dil ko kisi ke liye ek ajeeb sa, khoobsurat sa ehsaas hota hai… aur shayad yeh wohi waqt tha. ❤️

Is tasveer ko dekh kar mujhe woh feeling yaad aati hai jab dil ne chupke se kisi ko sirf dekhna nahi, balki usay dil se mehsoos karna shuru kiya tha. Shayad us waqt sab kuch simple lag raha tha, lekin andar kahin ek nayi si feeling janam le chuki thi. ✨

Yeh memory mere liye is liye special hai kyun ke yahin se woh ehsaas aur bhi gehra hota gaya. ❤️
PRIVATE MEMORY 3

Memory 03

🔐 09/06/2026
Pehli baar jab hum dono ki personal picture bani thi… ❤️

Woh sirf ek picture nahi thi. Mere liye woh un pehli yaadon mein se ek thi jahan hum dono ka apna ek chhota sa world feel hua. Camera ke saamne woh moment shayad bohat simple tha, lekin mere dil mein uski jagah bilkul simple nahi. 🥹❤️

Aaj jab yeh picture dekhta hoon to woh pehla sa excitement, woh closeness aur woh feeling dobara yaad aa jati hai. Kuch pictures waqt ke saath purani nahi hotin — woh aur zyada precious hoti jati hain. ♾️
PRIVATE MEMORY 4

Memory 04

🔐 06/08/2025
Phir woh waqt aaya jab pehli baar dil ko sach mein yeh khayal aaya ke hum ek doosre se door hone wale hain… ❤️‍🩹

Gate par woh last eye contact abhi tak yaad hai. Ek chhota sa lamha tha, lekin uske baad jo long distance shuru hua, us ne har chhoti cheez ki value samjha di. Tumhara door jana aur phir flight mein woh words — “Changa yara, apna khayal rakhi” — mere liye bohat heavy the. 🥺

Us waqt dil bohat down hua tha, kyun ke tum sirf ek jagah se doosri jagah nahi ja rahi thi… tum mujhse bohat door ja rahi thi. Aur phir har din tumhari kami aur zyada mehsoos hoti rahi. ❤️
PRIVATE MEMORY 5

Memory 05

🔐 16/02/2026
Aur phir… us long distance ke baad jab hum dono dobara mile. ❤️

Woh moment jab dobara tumhare saamne khara hua aur hum dono ka eye contact hua — mujhe woh feeling bohat zyada pasand hai. Itne time ki doori ke baad ek nazar mein jaise bohat kuch wapas mil gaya ho. 🥹❤️

Us waqt laga ke distance ne humein kam nahi kiya, balki har mulaqat ko aur zyada precious bana diya. Woh eye contact mere liye sirf ek look nahi tha; woh ek feeling thi ke haan… itni doori ke baad bhi hum wahi hain. ❤️♾️

Ahubk Bojoooooo. ❤️
PRIVATE MEMORY 6

Last Memory — Sorry

🔐 SORRY SORRY SORRY
Kabhi kabhi dil se nikli hui ek simple si baat bhi bohat kuch keh deti hai… is liye yeh page sirf ek word ke naam. ❤️

Sorry… sorry… sorry. 🥺❤️

Jo bhi hua, jo bhi baat dil ko lagi, bas itna yaad rakhna ke tum mere liye bohat special ho. Main nahi chahta ke hamari koi bhi achi yaad kisi ghalat feeling ke neeche dab jaye. Is liye yeh chhota sa “sorry” dil se hai — teen dafa, kyun ke ek dafa shayad kaafi nahi tha. ❤️‍🩹

Bas ab smile kar do… aur meri yeh memory bhi sambhal kar rakh lena. 🫶🏻
